## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Mixed (Top 5 span 3 sectors). Confirmations: Materials/Financials/Healthcare showing strength while Technology and Communication lag, and major divergence among large caps (META, GOOGL, TSLA) suppresses directional conviction.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Materials lead: NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.61% | 1M: +20.14%). Financials lead on pockets: PNC ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.36% | 1M: +6.42%). Healthcare strong: UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.82% | 1M: +8.26%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Communication weak: NFLX BELOW TREND (1W: -5.66% | 1M: -11.49%). Real Estate weak (sector 1W: -1.47%) with no clear leaders above trend. Technology under pressure: AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -4.47% | 1M: -9.25%) and MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.79% | 1M: -7.16%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.47% | 1M: +18.88%), INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.49% | 1M: +47.53%), NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.61% | 1M: +20.14%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.82% | 1M: +8.26%), GILD ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.70% | 1M: +5.51%). Leadership: Mixed (3 sectors in Top 5). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: NOW BELOW TREND (1W: -4.49% | 1M: -17.22%), IBM BELOW TREND (1W: -4.65% | 1M: -2.10%), CHTR BELOW TREND (1W: -4.78% | 1M: -6.01%), CRM BELOW TREND (1W: -4.79% | 1M: -12.24%), MMM BELOW TREND (1W: -5.51% | 1M: -0.82%). Weakness concentrated in large-cap Tech/Comm.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W movers: AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.47% | 1M: +18.88%), INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.49% | 1M: +47.53%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.60% | 1M: +24.33%). Watch META in RECOVERY (1W: +5.22% | 1M: -1.69%) and TSLA in RECOVERY (1W: +2.31% | 1M: -6.62%) — major divergence among large caps; treat as tactical, not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed with bifurcation: AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.47% | 1M: +18.88%), INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.49% | 1M: +47.53%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.93% | 1M: +2.13%), while AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -4.47% | 1M: -9.25%) and MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.79% | 1M: -7.16%). Sector shows internal rotation and headline-driven moves.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Patchy: PNC ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.36% | 1M: +6.42%) and select brokers showing strength vs. large caps lagging — JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.38% | 1M: -3.85%), V BELOW TREND (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -6.55%). Sector performing via pockets rather than broad leadership.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Defensive-to-cyclical mix: UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.82% | 1M: +8.26%), AMGN ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.50% | 1M: +6.01%), but ABT BELOW TREND (1W: -12.67% | 1M: -12.99%) and heavy negative news; breadth supportive but stock-level divergence exists.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor exposure to Materials and select Financial/Healthcare names showing ABOVE TREND (e.g., NEM, PNC, UNH) and reduce exposure to large-cap Tech laggards and earnings-disappointed names (AAPL BELOW TREND, ORCL BELOW TREND, ABT BELOW TREND). Style: mixed / no clear leadership — keep position sizing selective and monitor divergent large-cap signals.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.47% | 1M: +18.88%), INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.49% | 1M: +47.53%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.82% | 1M: +8.26%).  
BEARISH: ABT BELOW TREND (1W: -12.67% | 1M: -12.99%), ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -7.97% | 1M: -6.94%), NOW BELOW TREND (1W: -4.49% | 1M: -17.22%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Materials (sector 1W: +1.28%) and Healthcare (1W: +0.60%) — watch earnings/news catalysts.  
BEARISH: Communication (1W: -1.76%) and Real Estate (1W: -1.47%) given weaker 1W flows.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
AMD: breakout above recent 1W highs would confirm continuation of ABOVE TREND momentum;  
INTC: sustainment above the last week’s gains (confirm 1M strength) is key;  
AAPL: continued close below the 1W range would reinforce BELOW TREND status;  
ABT: follow-through on heavy sell-off and negative news (-85 sentiment) would keep it at risk.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
MRK (+60): Personalized cancer therapy 5-year data — sentiment confirmed by sector strength (Healthcare).  
AIG (+60): $3.5B CVC partnership headline — watch for fundamental follow-through (Financials).  
SLB (+55): Aramco win and tech expansion — Energy sentiment positive while sector 1W is slightly negative; cross-check operational updates.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
ABT (-85): Worst drop in 20+ years; price BELOW TREND (1W: -12.67% | 1M: -12.99%) — sentiment confirmed and high risk.  
JPM (-80): Legal headline; JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -1.38% | 1M: -3.85%) — sentiment and price aligned.  
INTC (-55): Negative outlook headlines but INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.49% | 1M: +47.53%) — clear divergence, monitor for distribution.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership.  
AMD ABOVE TREND, INTC ABOVE TREND and UNH ABOVE TREND are showing clear strength.  
Key risk: major large-cap divergences (META RECOVERY, GOOGL CORRECTION, ABT heavy negative sentiment) warrant tactical caution and close monitoring.
